home.title: Compress and export images from Figma, free | ImageRefold
home.description: A free, open-source Figma plugin that exports layers as WebP, AVIF, JPG and PNG, shows the file size before you save, and compresses images on your own computer.

hero.title: Lighter images, straight from Figma.
hero.lead: Export any layer as WebP, AVIF, JPG or PNG, see the file size before you save, and bring images back into Figma already compressed. Free, open source, and nothing leaves your computer.
hero.note: The Figma plugin is in development. Watch the repository to hear when the first release is out.

try.title: Try it on your own image.
try.text: Choose a picture and a format. This page compresses it in your browser, so you can see the size and the quality side by side. Nothing is uploaded.
try.drop: or drop one here. PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF or GIF.
try.note: This page uses your browser's own encoder. The plugin uses dedicated encoders that make smaller files.
try.compare: Move to compare the original with the result

features.title: Everything an export needs.
features.text: Pick the layers, pick the format, see the size. Then export them all at once, named the way your project needs.

formats.title: WebP, AVIF, JPG and PNG
formats.text: Lossy or lossless, with one quality control that means the same thing in every format.

preview.title: The size before you save
preview.text: Each file's size and its saving, with the original beside the result to compare.

scale.title: Every size at once
scale.text: 0.5×, 1×, 2×, 3× or an exact width, several in one export.

batch.title: Whole selections
batch.text: Every selected frame in one go, as separate files or one ZIP, named by a pattern you set.

import.title: Compressed on the way in
import.text: Drop images into Figma already light, or replace heavy image fills in place.

file.title: Settings that stay
file.text: Your formats and presets are remembered for each file.

privacy.title: Your images stay on your computer.
privacy.text: ImageRefold encodes every image inside Figma, on your machine. Its manifest allows no network access at all, so Figma itself blocks any request. No account, no server, no analytics.

open.title: Open source, down to the manifest.
open.text: Every line is on GitHub under the MIT licence. The manifest is the proof: it allows no domains, so nothing can be sent anywhere.
open.codeLabel: The plugin manifest, which allows no network access

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.lead: What people ask before they export their first image with ImageRefold.

howto.q: How do I export a compressed image from Figma?
howto.name: Export a compressed image from Figma with ImageRefold

select.name: Select the layers
select.text: Select the frames, groups or images you want to export.

choose.name: Choose the format
choose.text: Run ImageRefold and choose a format, a quality and the sizes you need.

export.name: Export
export.text: Check each file's size against the original, then export the files or a ZIP.

free.a: Yes. There are no plans, limits, trials, accounts or watermarks, and there never will be. ImageRefold is open source under the MIT licence.

upload.a: No. Every image is encoded inside the plugin, on your computer. The plugin is built with no network access, so it could not upload anything even by mistake.

formats.a: WebP, AVIF, JPG and PNG, lossy or lossless. Transparency is kept in WebP, AVIF and PNG.

file.q: Can it make my Figma file smaller?
file.a: Yes. ImageRefold can compress the images already placed in a file and swap them in place, so the file gets lighter and the design stays the same.

when.a: The plugin is in development. Watch the GitHub repository to hear when the first release reaches the Figma Community.

privacy.title: Privacy policy | ImageRefold
privacy.description: ImageRefold does not collect, transmit, sell or share any personal data. Your images are encoded on your computer and never uploaded.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: ImageRefold is a Figma plugin made by Shades Media Group. This policy covers the plugin and this website.
privacy.short: ImageRefold does not collect, transmit, sell or share any personal data. Your images never leave your computer.
privacy.pluginLayers: The layers you select, to export them as images in the format you choose.
privacy.pluginImages: Images you drop or open in the plugin, to compress them and place them in the current file.
privacy.pluginStorage: Figma's plugin storage, to remember your settings and presets.
privacy.pluginNetwork: The plugin is built with no network access: its manifest allows no domains, so Figma blocks any request. Encoding runs inside the plugin window, on your machine.
privacy.site: The website is static. It sets no cookies and loads no third-party scripts, fonts or trackers. The compression demo runs in your browser, and the image you choose is never sent anywhere. A display preference you choose stays in your browser.
privacy.data: None. There are no accounts, analytics, crash reports or tracking of any kind.
privacy.children: ImageRefold is a design tool and is not directed at children.
privacy.changes: Changes to this policy are published on this page and noted in the changelog.

consent.title: Your privacy
consent.text: This site keeps only what it needs to work, like your display settings. Analytics or marketing tools would run only with your yes.
consent.necessaryText: Remembers your display and privacy choices. Always on.
consent.analyticsText: Anonymous visit counts, to learn what helps. Not in use on this site today.
consent.marketingText: Ads and campaign measurement. Not in use on this site today.
